test_title: PYST 205: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 29th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it. 

 
 

 23
 63
 34
 
 

 31
 ?
 28
 
 

 27
 63
 18
solution:
Here the pattern followed in each row is:

(1st number × 2) + (3rd number ÷ 2) = 2ⁿd number

**Row 1:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e9e8ab7adf5d58b4d5b3cf4ee6bf2293d1684956b720e102ecfe5603fa88f08.png] 

(23 × 2) + (34 ÷ 2) = 46 +17 = 63 = Second number

**Row 3 **: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/368808214fe785de6204620a2afd93221fb913bae9650927c1c9bc451d7aff3c.png] 

(27 × 2) + (18 ÷ 2) = 54 + 9 = 63 = Second number

Similarly

Row 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45dd9047be5c8c62a002145a55eb0be41368c8b04fbb626732570efa71077967.png] 

**(31 × 2) + (28 ÷ 2) = 62 + 14 = 76 = Second number**

Hence, “76” is correct answer.
